name: Hi-To-Mi
source:
After a guy recovered from an accident, girls seem to be attracted to him. It turned out that he can influence their feelings. Can he resist this power and stay true to the girl he loves?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个男人从事故中恢复过来后，女孩似乎会被他吸引。原来他可以影响他们的感情。他能抵抗这种力量并忠于他所爱的女孩吗？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]李家欢乐屋[/url]]
